title: Standalone ListIdentity discovery request
purpose: Provide a canonical discovery operation with an empty request payload and a frame shape distinct from session and CPF data exchanges.
expected_behavior: A conforming discovery parser can recognize the ListIdentity encapsulation command with zero payload length.
constraints_preserved: The EtherNet/IP encapsulation header is 24 bytes
The encoded payload length is zero and matches the absent payload
The command uses little-endian field encoding
The seed covers a discovery path distinct from explicit and connected messaging
issue_safety_notes: This is a conservative model-prior discovery seed; validity is not externally verified and no issue or vulnerability claim is made.
